description: This file defines classes related to OAuth2 security schemes in FastAPI, including request forms, OAuth2 flow dependencies, and scope management.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
classes.description: Dependency class for OAuth2 password flow form data collection, including username, password, scope, client_id, and client_secret.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordRequestFormStrict
classes.description: Strict version of OAuth2PasswordRequestForm that enforces 'grant_type' as 'password'.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Base class for OAuth2 authentication schemes, handling OAuth2 flows and authorization header processing.

classes.name: OAuth2PasswordBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow for bearer token obtained via password, used as a dependency.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer
classes.description: OAuth2 flow for bearer token obtained via authorization code, used as a dependency.

classes.name: SecurityScopes
classes.description: Class to manage and aggregate OAuth2 scopes required by dependencies.

methods.name: make_not_authenticated_error
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 exception with WWW-Authenticate header for OAuth2.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the Authorization header, parses it, and returns the token or raises error if not authorized.
